# Order = teaching order. Example = the phrase in use, often with the reply you'll hear.
# Phrases — Getting by
p001|我听不懂。|Wǒ tīng bu dǒng.|I don't understand (what you said).|我听不懂，请再说一遍。|Wǒ tīng bu dǒng, qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.|I don't understand, please say it again.
p002|请说慢一点。|Qǐng shuō màn yìdiǎn.|Please speak a little slower.|对不起，请说慢一点。|Duìbuqǐ, qǐng shuō màn yìdiǎn.|Sorry, please speak a bit slower.
p003|你说得太快了。|Nǐ shuō de tài kuài le.|You're talking too fast.|你说得太快了，我听不懂。|Nǐ shuō de tài kuài le, wǒ tīng bu dǒng.|You're talking too fast; I can't follow.
p004|我会说一点儿中文。|Wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎnr Zhōngwén.|I can speak a little Chinese.|我会说一点儿中文，可是说得不好。|Wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎnr Zhōngwén, kěshì shuō de bù hǎo.|I speak a little Chinese, but not well.
p005|我小时候听过中文。|Wǒ xiǎoshíhou tīngguo Zhōngwén.|I heard Chinese as a kid.|我小时候听过中文，可是不太会说。|Wǒ xiǎoshíhou tīngguo Zhōngwén, kěshì bú tài huì shuō.|I heard Chinese as a kid, but I can't really speak it.
p006|这是什么意思？|Zhè shì shénme yìsi?|What does this mean?|对不起，这是什么意思？|Duìbuqǐ, zhè shì shénme yìsi?|Sorry, what does this mean?
p007|这个用中文怎么说？|Zhège yòng Zhōngwén zěnme shuō?|How do you say this in Chinese?|请问，这个用中文怎么说？|Qǐngwèn, zhège yòng Zhōngwén zěnme shuō?|Excuse me, how do you say this in Chinese?
# Phrases — Polite basics
p008|不好意思。|Bù hǎoyìsi.|Excuse me / sorry to bother you.|不好意思，请问洗手间在哪儿？|Bù hǎoyìsi, qǐngwèn xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr?|Excuse me, where's the restroom?
p009|没关系。|Méi guānxi.|That's OK (reply to "sorry").|对不起！——没关系。|Duìbuqǐ! — Méi guānxi.|Sorry! — That's OK.
p010|不用谢。|Bú yòng xiè.|No need to thank me.|谢谢你！——不用谢。|Xièxie nǐ! — Bú yòng xiè.|Thank you! — Don't mention it.
p011|好的，没问题。|Hǎo de, méi wèntí.|OK, no problem.|能帮我一下吗？——好的，没问题。|Néng bāng wǒ yíxià ma? — Hǎo de, méi wèntí.|Can you help me? — OK, no problem.
p012|等一下。|Děng yíxià.|Wait a moment.|请等一下，我马上来。|Qǐng děng yíxià, wǒ mǎshàng lái.|Please wait a moment, I'll be right there.
p013|能帮我一下吗？|Néng bāng wǒ yíxià ma?|Could you help me?|不好意思，能帮我一下吗？|Bù hǎoyìsi, néng bāng wǒ yíxià ma?|Excuse me, could you help me?
# Phrases — Food & ordering
p014|几位？|Jǐ wèi?|How many people? (you'll hear this)|你好，几位？——两位。|Nǐ hǎo, jǐ wèi? — Liǎng wèi.|Hi, how many? — Two.
p015|有菜单吗？|Yǒu càidān ma?|Is there a menu?|你好，有英文菜单吗？|Nǐ hǎo, yǒu Yīngwén càidān ma?|Hi, is there an English menu?
p016|我要这个。|Wǒ yào zhège.|I'll have this one.|服务员，我要这个，谢谢。|Fúwùyuán, wǒ yào zhège, xièxie.|Waiter, I'll have this, thanks.
p017|这个辣吗？|Zhège là ma?|Is this spicy?|这个辣吗？——有一点儿辣。|Zhège là ma? — Yǒu yìdiǎnr là.|Is this spicy? — A little.
p018|不要辣。|Bú yào là.|No spice, please.|这个菜不要辣，谢谢。|Zhège cài bú yào là, xièxie.|No spice in this dish, please.
p019|我要一杯水。|Wǒ yào yì bēi shuǐ.|I'd like a glass of water.|你好，我要一杯水，谢谢。|Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào yì bēi shuǐ, xièxie.|Hi, a glass of water please.
p020|在这儿吃还是带走？|Zài zhèr chī háishi dài zǒu?|For here or to go? (you'll hear this)|在这儿吃还是带走？——带走，谢谢。|Zài zhèr chī háishi dài zǒu? — Dài zǒu, xièxie.|For here or to go? — To go, thanks.
p021|很好吃！|Hěn hǎochī!|It's delicious!|这个菜很好吃！|Zhège cài hěn hǎochī!|This dish is delicious!
p022|我吃饱了。|Wǒ chī bǎo le.|I'm full.|我吃饱了，谢谢！|Wǒ chī bǎo le, xièxie!|I'm full, thank you!
p023|买单。|Mǎidān.|The bill, please.|服务员，买单！|Fúwùyuán, mǎidān!|Waiter, the bill please!
# Phrases — Shopping & paying
p024|多少钱？|Duōshao qián?|How much is it?|这个多少钱？——二十块。|Zhège duōshao qián? — Èrshí kuài.|How much is this? — Twenty yuan.
p025|太贵了！|Tài guì le!|Too expensive!|太贵了！我不要了。|Tài guì le! Wǒ bú yào le.|Too expensive! I'll pass.
p026|能便宜一点儿吗？|Néng piányi yìdiǎnr ma?|Can you make it cheaper?|能便宜一点儿吗？——好吧，十五块。|Néng piányi yìdiǎnr ma? — Hǎo ba, shíwǔ kuài.|Can you make it cheaper? — OK, fifteen yuan.
p027|我先看看。|Wǒ xiān kànkan.|I'm just looking.|我先看看，谢谢。|Wǒ xiān kànkan, xièxie.|I'm just looking first, thanks.
p028|有没有大一点儿的？|Yǒu méiyǒu dà yìdiǎnr de?|Do you have a bigger one?|这个太小了，有没有大一点儿的？|Zhège tài xiǎo le, yǒu méiyǒu dà yìdiǎnr de?|This is too small — do you have a bigger one?
p029|可以扫码吗？|Kěyǐ sǎo mǎ ma?|Can I pay by scanning a QR code?|可以扫码吗？——可以，扫这儿。|Kěyǐ sǎo mǎ ma? — Kěyǐ, sǎo zhèr.|Can I scan to pay? — Yes, scan here.
p030|可以刷卡吗？|Kěyǐ shuā kǎ ma?|Can I pay by card?|可以刷卡吗？——不可以，只能扫码。|Kěyǐ shuā kǎ ma? — Bù kěyǐ, zhǐ néng sǎo mǎ.|Can I pay by card? — No, QR code only.
# Phrases — Meeting people
p031|很高兴认识你。|Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ.|Nice to meet you.|你好，很高兴认识你！|Nǐ hǎo, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ!|Hi, nice to meet you!
p032|你叫什么名字？|Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?|What's your name?|你好！你叫什么名字？|Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?|Hi! What's your name?
p033|你是哪国人？|Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?|What country are you from?|你是哪国人？你是中国人吗？|Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? Nǐ shì Zhōngguó rén ma?|Where are you from? Are you Chinese?
p034|你做什么工作？|Nǐ zuò shénme gōngzuò?|What do you do for work?|你做什么工作？——我是老师。|Nǐ zuò shénme gōngzuò? — Wǒ shì lǎoshī.|What do you do? — I'm a teacher.
p035|你住在哪儿？|Nǐ zhù zài nǎr?|Where do you live?|你住在哪儿？——我住在北京。|Nǐ zhù zài nǎr? — Wǒ zhù zài Běijīng.|Where do you live? — I live in Beijing.
p036|我是第一次来。|Wǒ shì dì yī cì lái.|It's my first time here.|我是第一次来中国。|Wǒ shì dì yī cì lái Zhōngguó.|It's my first time in China.
# Phrases — Getting around
p037|洗手间在哪儿？|Xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr?|Where's the restroom?|请问，洗手间在哪儿？——在那边。|Qǐngwèn, xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr? — Zài nàbiān.|Excuse me, where's the restroom? — Over there.

p038|地铁站怎么走？|Dìtiě zhàn zěnme zǒu?|How do I get to the subway station?|请问，地铁站怎么走？——一直往前走。|Qǐngwèn, dìtiě zhàn zěnme zǒu? — Yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu.|Excuse me, how do I get to the subway? — Go straight ahead.
p039|远吗？|Yuǎn ma?|Is it far?|远吗？——不远，走路五分钟。|Yuǎn ma? — Bù yuǎn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng.|Is it far? — No, five minutes on foot.
p040|往左拐。|Wǎng zuǒ guǎi.|Turn left.|往前走，然后往左拐。|Wǎng qián zǒu, ránhòu wǎng zuǒ guǎi.|Go straight, then turn left.
p041|往右拐。|Wǎng yòu guǎi.|Turn right.|到路口往右拐。|Dào lùkǒu wǎng yòu guǎi.|Turn right at the intersection.
p042|师傅，去这个地方。|Shīfu, qù zhège dìfang.|Driver, please go to this place.|师傅，去这个地方，谢谢。|Shīfu, qù zhège dìfang, xièxie.|Driver, to this place please.
p043|在这儿停就行。|Zài zhèr tíng jiù xíng.|You can stop here.|师傅，在这儿停就行。|Shīfu, zài zhèr tíng jiù xíng.|Driver, stopping here is fine.
p044|我迷路了。|Wǒ mílù le.|I'm lost.|不好意思，我迷路了，这是哪儿？|Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ mílù le, zhè shì nǎr?|Excuse me, I'm lost — where is this?
# Phrases — Hotel & needs
p045|我有预订。|Wǒ yǒu yùdìng.|I have a reservation.|你好，我有预订。这是我的护照。|Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yǒu yùdìng. Zhè shì wǒ de hùzhào.|Hi, I have a reservation. Here's my passport.
p046|几点退房？|Jǐ diǎn tuì fáng?|What time is checkout?|请问，几点退房？——十二点。|Qǐngwèn, jǐ diǎn tuì fáng? — Shí'èr diǎn.|Excuse me, what time is checkout? — Twelve.
p047|无线网密码是多少？|Wúxiàn wǎng mìmǎ shì duōshao?|What's the Wi-Fi password?|请问，无线网密码是多少？|Qǐngwèn, wúxiàn wǎng mìmǎ shì duōshao?|Excuse me, what's the Wi-Fi password?
p048|可以拍照吗？|Kěyǐ pāizhào ma?|Can I take photos?|这儿可以拍照吗？——可以。|Zhèr kěyǐ pāizhào ma? — Kěyǐ.|Can I take photos here? — Yes.
p049|我不舒服。|Wǒ bù shūfu.|I don't feel well.|我有点儿不舒服，想休息一下。|Wǒ yǒudiǎnr bù shūfu, xiǎng xiūxi yíxià.|I don't feel well; I want to rest a bit.
# Phrases — Everyday conversation
p050|你吃饭了吗？|Nǐ chī fàn le ma?|Have you eaten? (a common greeting)|你吃饭了吗？——吃了，你呢？|Nǐ chī fàn le ma? — Chī le, nǐ ne?|Have you eaten? — Yes, and you?
p051|最近怎么样？|Zuìjìn zěnmeyàng?|How have you been lately?|好久不见！最近怎么样？|Hǎojiǔ bú jiàn! Zuìjìn zěnmeyàng?|Long time no see! How have you been?
p052|还可以。|Hái kěyǐ.|Not bad / so-so.|最近怎么样？——还可以，有点儿忙。|Zuìjìn zěnmeyàng? — Hái kěyǐ, yǒudiǎnr máng.|How's it going? — Not bad, a bit busy.
p053|多吃点儿！|Duō chī diǎnr!|Eat more! (you'll hear this)|多吃点儿，别客气！|Duō chī diǎnr, bié kèqi!|Eat more, don't be shy!
p054|你有兄弟姐妹吗？|Nǐ yǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi ma?|Do you have siblings?|你有兄弟姐妹吗？——我有一个哥哥。|Nǐ yǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi ma? — Wǒ yǒu yí ge gēge.|Do you have siblings? — I have an older brother.
p055|你周末做什么？|Nǐ zhōumò zuò shénme?|What do you do on weekends?|你周末做什么？——我喜欢看电影。|Nǐ zhōumò zuò shénme? — Wǒ xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng.|What do you do on weekends? — I like watching movies.
p056|我也是。|Wǒ yě shì.|Me too.|我很喜欢吃饺子。——我也是！|Wǒ hěn xǐhuan chī jiǎozi. — Wǒ yě shì!|I love dumplings. — Me too!
p057|真的吗？|Zhēn de ma?|Really?|我会说三种语言。——真的吗？|Wǒ huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔyán. — Zhēn de ma?|I speak three languages. — Really?
p058|我想你了。|Wǒ xiǎng nǐ le.|I missed you.|好久不见，我很想你！|Hǎojiǔ bú jiàn, wǒ hěn xiǎng nǐ!|Long time no see, I missed you!
